title: First LedgerCloseMeta v2: parallel Soroban phase and fee refunds after all transactions
why: The first ledger after the Protocol 23 upgrade uses LedgerCloseMeta v2: the Soroban phase is v1 (execution stages of clusters), each Soroban result carries postTxApplyFeeProcessing, and refunds are after_all_txs fee events instead of after_tx. Readers on the v1 layout find no Soroban transactions or miss the refunds.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger, the first after the Protocol 23 upgrade, captured for this entry.

notes: 273 transactions: 185 classic in phase 0, 88 Soroban in one execution stage of one cluster; all 88 have post_tx_apply_fee_processing and an after_all_txs fee event. The first Soroban transaction in apply order is index 185 (acb9eac8…), a fee bump: fee source GBGWQFSJ… debited 217550 and refunded 105658. The lake object was written by stellar-core 24.1.0 long after the ledger closed (source.regenerated true), so its TransactionMeta is v4 with backfilled classic and fee events, not what a node emitted at the time.
